summary: Kopin Corporation filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 reporting that Theon International Plc converted 1,000 shares of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock into 2,380,973 shares of common stock at a fixed conversion price of $3.00 per share. The preferred stock was retired. This conversion stemmed from a strategic investment announced in October 2025, where Theon acquired a 49% interest in Kopin Europe Ltd. and purchased the preferred shares. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned. The event is a routine contractual conversion, not a special situation. No premium, break fee, or tender offer is involved. What to watch: no further action required; this is a post-closing conversion.
